Artificial intelligence is growing by leaps and bounds. It's no longer science fiction anymore! 

Lots of AI tools can serve as our own personal assistants -- answering questions, helping us write text, create images, speak more effectively, and more.

Time has always been a barrier in the classroom. Most teachers would agree that they would be able to do more -- including the things that are most important -- if they had more time.

Teachers can find AI tools that are ready to help them out right now. Lots of them are free or have "freemium" plans with limited free options.

Below is a description of AI and how you can start using it to support your work in class.

What is artificial intelligence?

Artificial intelligence (AI) refers to the ability of a computer or machine to perform tasks that would normally require human intelligence, such as learning, problem-solving, decision-making, and more. There are several different approaches to building AI systems, including machine learning, where a system is trained on a dataset and can improve its performance over time, and rule-based systems, where the system follows a set of predetermined rules to make decisions. 

AI can be applied to a wide range of areas, including natural language processing, image and video recognition and robotics. The goal of AI research is to create systems that can perform tasks at least as well as, or ideally better than, humans. AI has the potential to revolutionize many industries and transform the way we live and work, but it also raises important ethical and social questions.

50 AI tools for the classroom

We have gathered 50 of our favorite AI tools for teachers to be used in the classroom below. You can scroll down and check them all out or jump to any category of tools by clicking on the icon below.

Note: Pricing is accurate as of our most recent update in November 2026.

Chatbots

Google Gemini for Education

Gemini is Google’s powerful AI assistant—built specifically for schools. Gemini for Education includes:

  • Access to Google’s flagship Gemini models (including Gemini Pro and Deep Research) for all Google Workspace for Education users
  • Built-in enterprise-grade privacy protections (data is not used to train models), certified by Common Sense Media
  • Admin-managed access for safe and age-appropriate use by students
  • Deep integration across Google Classroom, Docs, Slides, Gmail, and Forms

How it works: Built directly into Google Workspace for Education, Gemini offers over 30 educator and student tools—including interactive diagrams, quiz generation, automated overviews, Guided Learning, and a connected Google Classroom app that lets teachers securely draft curriculum-aligned lessons and track student progress.

Pricing and terms:

  • Gemini for Education (Free): Included at no cost for all qualifying Google Workspace for Education institutions.
  • Google AI Pro for Education ($20–$24/user/month, or $15/user/month with eligible Education Plus volume commitments): Unlocks higher usage limits, expanded NotebookLM/Gemini Notebook allowances, and full generative AI features embedded directly inside Docs, Gmail, Slides, Meet, and Google Vids.

Check it out: edu.google.com/ai/gemini-for-education

Learn more: Google Gemini 101 for teachers: Getting started with Google’s AI assistant

Claude

Claude (claude.ai) is an AI assistant created by Anthropic. Claude can process large amounts of information, brainstorm ideas, generate text, interactive visual artifacts, and code, help you understand subjects, coach you through difficult situations, and simplify busywork so you can focus on what matters most.

How it works: Log in to Claude and ask it a question, upload documents, or create interactive Artifacts (like instant quizzes, flashcards, or visual diagrams right inside the chat). With Claude for Teachers, verified educators also get built-in connections to all 50 states' standards via Learning Commons, vetted curricula (like OpenSciEd and Illustrative Mathematics), and direct integrations with Canva, MagicSchool, Brisk, Diffit, and Snorkl.

Pricing and terms: It's a "freemium" tool, meaning there's a free plan and a paid premium plan. 

  • Free: Basic access for chat, file analysis, and content creation with standard usage limits.
  • Claude for Teachers (Free through July 2028): Verified U.S. K–12 teachers (and school/district deployments) receive Pro-level Claude access completely free, including higher usage limits, Projects, and education curriculum connectors.
  • Pro ($17/month with annual subscription) / Max ($100/month): Individual paid plans for non-educators or power users needing expanded usage limits.

Check it out:  claude.ai

Learn more: Claude for Teachers: How to get started (plus 8 ways to use it in class) 

Microsoft Copilot

Microsoft Copilot is an AI assistant powered by frontier models (including OpenAI's GPT-5 series and Anthropic's Claude models) that can help you browse the web, answer questions, analyze documents, and draft content. It can be accessed through the Copilot website, the Microsoft Edge browser, or mobile apps, and can be used to ask simple and complex questions, summarize articles or news, generate images, and brainstorm lesson ideas.

How it works:  Just go to copilot.microsoft.com. (You’ll need to be logged in to a Microsoft account.) When you do, you can 

  • Provide Copilot with questions or prompts and get detailed responses powered by generative AI
  • Choose your preferred AI model or let Copilot automatically route your request for quick answers or deep reasoning
  • Upload images or documents that you want the AI assistant to analyze
  • Ask questions with your voice using the microphone button
  • Get AI-generated responses on the go with the Copilot mobile app

Pricing and terms:  

  • Free: Core web and mobile chat, web search, and image generation are free for all users.
  • Paid Plans: Microsoft 365 Copilot add-ons (starting around $18–$21/user/month billed annually for eligible institutional/business plans) integrate Copilot directly into Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.

Check it out: Go to copilot.microsoft.com. 

Learn more:  Copilot for Educators Course.

ChatGPT

ChatGPT is a generative AI chatbot that interacts with you conversationally, the way a human would. It's trained on vast amounts of information and designed to help you brainstorm, draft materials, analyze files, and solve complex problems in an intuitive, natural way.

How it works: Ask ChatGPT a question or give it a request, and it will respond. Beyond standard chat, educators heavily rely on Projects (to organize lesson files and custom instructions by unit or class) and Canvas (an interactive side-by-side workspace for writing and editing documents or code directly with the AI).

Pricing and terms: ChatGPT offers a free plan, paid individual tiers, and a dedicated free workspace for verified K–12 teachers:

  • Free: Gives you access to core chat, web search, file uploads, and image generation using OpenAI's flagship models (such as the GPT-5 series) with standard usage caps.
  • ChatGPT for Teachers (Free through June 2028): OpenAI offers a dedicated, FERPA-ready workspace free for verified U.S. K–12 teachers and school staff. It includes unlimited messages with flagship models, file connectors (Google Drive, Microsoft 365, Canva), and school/district admin controls.
  • ChatGPT Plus ($20/month): Designed for individual power users who want higher message limits, deep research tools, and priority access to new features.

Check it out:  chatgpt.com

Learn more: There are lots of ways you can use it in the classroom, as detailed in this post: ChatGPT, Chatbots, and Artificial Intelligence in the Classroom.

Gemini Notebook/NotebookLM

Gemini Notebook (formerly known as NotebookLM) is Google's personalized AI research assistant. Instead of pulling answers from the open internet, it grounds its responses strictly in the sources you upload—turning your notes, PDFs, Google Docs, YouTube videos, and web links into study guides, flashcards, mind maps, and interactive Audio Overviews (AI-generated two-host podcast discussions about your materials).

How it works: Create a notebook and upload up to 50 sources (such as unit readings, standards documents, or lecture notes). You can ask questions with inline citations pointing directly back to your files, generate instant study guides or quizzes, or generate a customizable Audio Overview that teachers and students can listen to—or even jump into interactively—to review complex topics.

Pricing and terms: 

  • Free (Standard): Free with any Google account, including up to 100 notebooks, 50 sources per notebook, and generous rolling usage limits for chats and Audio Overviews.
  • Paid Plans: Higher notebook counts, source limits (100–600 sources per notebook), and expanded daily quotas are bundled into Google AI Plus ($4.99/month), Google AI Pro ($19.99/month), and Google AI Pro for Education Workspace plans.

Check it out: Meet Google NotebookLM: 10 things to know for educators

Take the Course

Perplexity

Perplexity is another generative AI chatbot that lets users ask questions and get responses conversationally. What seems to set Perplexity apart is that it cites sources, which are easily clickable to get more context and more information.

How it works: Go to Perplexity and ask it a question about or request something. You'll see the concise version at first, but you can click to see a detailed response. It will also list the sources where it drew its information and other related topics. You can ask follow up questions, in a conversational manner like ChatGPT.

Pricing and terms: It's a "freemium" tool, meaning there's a free plan and a paid premium plan.

  • Free: Includes unlimited quick searches, file uploads, and a limited number of daily "Pro Searches" using advanced reasoning models.
  • Pro ($20/month or $200/year): Offers 300+ Pro Searches per day, access to multiple frontier AI models, unlimited file uploads, and image generation.
  • Max ($200/month or $2,000/year): Top-tier individual plan providing unlimited access to advanced models and early access to new features.

Check it out:  perplexity.ai

Learn more: perplexity.ai/hub/getting-started

Sorcerer by Antimatter 

Antimatter has added to its fun meme and text messaging classroom tools with Sorcerer  (playantimatter.com/sorcerer) . Create a sorcerer -- an AI chatbot -- and choose topics it'll discuss with your students. As students interact with the Sorcerer, it ranks the student's mastery of the topic, increasing it as the student shows more and more proficiency.

How it works: Create an account at antimatter.systems (or playantimatter.com/sorcerer) and click the Sorcerer button. Create a sorcerer and share the link with students.

Pricing and terms: The platform is free for teachers to use. It allows you to create and run activities, and for students to participate. This includes access to the core meme and text messaging tools, as well as the "Sorcerer" AI chatbot.

Check it out: Go to antimatter.systems to get started.

Visual & Design Tools

Adobe Express

Adobe Express incorporates Adobe's Firefly generative AI model, which gives users new ways to bring their ideas to life. With generative AI, you can create custom images and text effects using text prompts. As an educator you can use this feature to generate unique and engaging visuals for your lessons and activities.

How it works: You can access Adobe's generative AI tools directly from the Adobe Express all-in-one editor.

Pricing and terms:  


  • Adobe Express for Education (Free): Free for K–12 students and educators. It provides all the premium features of Adobe Express.
  • Individual Plans: Adobe Express Free ($0/month) includes basic editing tools and limited generative AI credits; Adobe Express Premium ($9.99/month) and Adobe Firefly Pro ($19.99/month) add more credits, stock assets, and web/mobile Photoshop access.

Check it out: Firefly.adobe.com and check out our post 5 reasons why Adobe Express is a must-have tool for your classroom to learn more.

Ideogram

Ideogram (ideogram.ai) is an AI image generator. Type a description of the image you'd like to generate -- or choose features of the image from selectable options below the prompt. Ideogram generates your image -- and it can even improve your description/prompt with AI. 

How it works: Go to the Ideogram website to log in with a Google or Apple account.

Pricing and terms:

  • Free ($0/month): Includes a limited number of "slow credits" for public image generations.
  • Basic ($7/month billed yearly or $8/month billed monthly): Provides priority credits, daily slow credits, and Canvas editing tools.
  • Plus ($15/month billed yearly or $20/month billed monthly) & Pro ($42/month billed yearly or $60/month billed monthly): Add private generations, image remixing, Character Consistency, and batch generation.

Check it out: ideogram.ai

Learn more: 10 Free AI image generators for classroom uses

Microsoft Designer

Microsoft Designer (designer.microsoft.com) is a graphic design app that uses AI to help users create professional-quality designs quickly. Users can start with their own ideas or images, and Designer will generate unique designs and offer personalized recommendations. My favorite feature: create fill-in-the-blank prompts that you can share for others to use.

How it works: Go to designer.microsoft.com and log in. Create images -- or use other tools like remove background, album creator, design creator, and more.

Plans and Pricing:

  • Free: Available for free as a web app with basic content creation tools and 15 monthly credits. You will receive a fresh set of credits at the start of each month, and 1 credit will be deducted from your balance each time you interact Designer's AI features.
  • Included with Microsoft 365 Subscriptions: Full access with higher generative AI credit limits is included with paid Microsoft 365 plans.

Check it out: designer.microsoft.com

Learn more: Capture creativity with Microsoft Designer prompts in the classroom

Canva AI

Canva's AI assistant is designed for a natural, chat-like interaction and supports multimodal input such as voice, text, and images. The designs it creates are fully editable, and you can access them across different devices. Canva AI is available with a free account for limited use, with more features available through a Canva Free Canva EDU Pro account.

How it works:  Canva offers an all-in-one conversational AI assistant that combines various generative AI tools to help with creative and design needs. The key AI tools and features include:

  • Design for me: Creates fully editable designs based on your text or voice prompts.
  • Create an image: Generates visuals powered by Dream Lab.
  • Draft a doc: Uses Magic Write™ to quickly draft content or get insights from existing documents.
  • Canva Code: Generates interactive elements like mini-games or calculators without coding.

Pricing and terms: Get your free Canva EDU Pro account by getting verified at canva.com/education.

Check it out: canva.com/canva-ai

Learn more: Canva AI in the Classroom Course

Google Vids

Google Vids is an AI-powered video creation app that's part of Google Workspace. It's a simple, school-friendly way for both teachers and students to create short videos using templates, voiceovers, and stock media. It's designed to help you create polished video content without the need for complex software, and it's integrated with tools like Drive and Classroom.

How it works:  You can start with a simple text prompt to generate a fully editable storyboard with suggested scenes, scripts, and background music. Vids also offers a "teleprompter" for recording yourself, AI voiceovers, and tools to automatically remove filler words from a transcript. Some of the generative AI features, such as creating video clips from images and AI avatars, are available on a limited promotional basis for certain plans.

Pricing and terms: Google Vids is included with Google Workspace for Education. While the basic video editor is available to all users, the advanced generative AI features require a paid add-on, such as the Google AI Pro for Education plan.

Check it out: Go to workspace.google.com/products/vids.

Learn more: How to use Google Vids: AI powered video creation in the classroom

Prezi AI

Built for attention and flexibility, Prezi AI transforms your outlines, PDFs, or even existing presentations into dynamic, cinematic lessons that feel more like storytelling than lecturing. Prezi is a dynamic presentation tool that uses a non-linear, zoomable canvas to create engaging and memorable presentations.

How it works:  Prezi's AI assistant can help you brainstorm and structure your presentation. Type a prompt or drop in a file, and the AI will generate an outline, visual layout, and color scheme on a zoomable canvas that you can customize.

  • Custom-Designed Presentations: Just drop in your topic or file — Prezi AI turns it into something stunning.
  • Fast Creation: From idea to presentation in the time it takes to make your morning coffee.
  • Non-linear Canvas: Zooming, panning, and cinematic movement keep students locked in.
  • AI Suggestions: Get personalized color schemes, visuals, and structure while staying in control.

Pricing and terms: Prezi offers various plans, including a dedicated and heavily discounted option for educators.

  • Prezi Basic (Free): Essential creation tools, public presentations, and 500 AI presentation generation credits.
  • Prezi Edu Plus ($4/month billed annually) / Edu Pro ($8/month) / Edu Teams ($19/month per user): Discounted plans for verified students, teachers, and school teams adding unlimited private presentations, offline desktop access, and analytics.

Check it out: Prez.is/mattmiller

Learn more: 10 AI presentation tools to level up your lessons 

Gamma

Gamma lets you skip the formatting and focus on ideas. Just type your topic or paste in a lesson outline, and the AI creates a polished, scrollable presentation that blends text, visuals, and even interactive elements.

How it works:  Simply type your topic, and Gamma's AI will generate a complete outline and presentation draft. You can then edit the content, choose different themes, and add multimedia. The tool's AI can also rewrite text, summarize content, or generate new images directly within the presentation.

Pricing and terms: Gamma is a "freemium" tool with a tiered pricing model based on AI credits, which are used for advanced features.

  • Free: Includes 400 AI credits upon sign-up and basic features for creating presentations, documents, and websites.
  • Plus ($10/month per user): Unlimited AI creations, 1,000 monthly credits, and removes the "Made with Gamma" badge.
  • Pro ($25/month per user) & Ultra ($100/month per user): Add 4,000–20,000 monthly credits, custom branding, analytics, and advanced AI models.

Check it out: https://gamma.app/

Learn more: 10 AI presentation tools to level up your lessons

Lesson Design & Content Creation Tools

Curipod

Give Curipod (curipod.com/ai) a topic, and it will generate an interactive slide deck for you in seconds, including:

  • Polls
  • Word clouds
  • Open-ended questions
  • A drawing tool

How it works: Once you have a slide deck (which generates 9–12 interactive slides on your topic), you can edit and adjust to suit your needs, add your own slides, and get instant AI feedback on student responses during live lessons.

Pricing and terms: It has a free plan and a paid premium plan, and the free plan includes almost everything most teachers need to run interactive lessons. You can check out the premium features on the pricing page.

Check it out:  curipod.com/ai

Learn more: 10 ways Curipod engages your students with AI

Diffit

Diffit allows you to get leveled resources for literally anything. You can adapt existing materials for any reader, generate “just right” resources for any topic and then edit and share resources with students.

How it works: Go to web.diffit.me and search for a topic, term, or question, enter a URL, or paste copied text. Choose a reading level and language and click "generate resources." Diffit will automatically generate leveled passages, vocabulary, summaries, and comprehension activities ready to export to Google Docs, Slides, Forms, or printable PDFs.

Diffit offers a tiered pricing model for educators:

  • Free: An "always free" version that allows teachers to generate, adapt, and customize learning resources (plus a 60-day free trial of premium features for new accounts).
  • Individual Teacher Subscription ($14.99/month): Unlocks additional templates, export options, and higher usage limits.
  • Schoolwide License (Custom Quote): Flat-rate annual subscription based on school size with unlimited access for all staff.

Note: First-year teachers can get free unlimited Premium access through June 30, 2027, by filling out an application on the Diffit First Year Free Page.

Check it out: Go to web.diffit.me and sign up for your free account. 

Learn more: Become a Diffit certified educator

MagicSchool.ai

MagicSchool.ai is an AI-powered educational platform designed to help teachers save time by automating tasks such as lesson planning, differentiation, IEP writing, grading, and generating classroom content. It offers over 80 AI teacher tools (plus 50+ moderated student tools) that are searchable by keyword and categorized for planning, student support, communication, and productivity. MagicSchool is built on best practices for educators, compliant with FERPA and COPPA, and includes built-in safeguards for school use.

How it works: Visit MagicSchool and choose a tool. Enter the specific details you need to generate your resource—for example, if you choose the YouTube Question Generator, you'll enter the grade level, number of questions, question type, and video URL. You can also launch Student Rooms to give students safe, teacher-monitored access to AI tutors and writing feedback tools.

Pricing and terms: MagicSchool.ai offers a tiered pricing model with options for individuals, schools, and districts:

  • Free: A "free forever" plan that provides educators with access to over 80 teacher AI tools, the AI chatbot Raina, quizzes, and class writing feedback with standard usage limits.
  • Plus ($99.96/year or $8.33/month billed annually; $12.99 billed monthly): Unlocks unlimited generations, unlimited output history and editing, full access to 50+ student tools, and one-click exports to Google and Microsoft.
  • Enterprise / School & District Plans (Custom Quote): Adds school- and district-wide customizations, advanced data analytics, custom Data Privacy Agreements (DPAs), Single Sign-On (SSO), and LMS integrations (Canvas, Schoology, Google Classroom).

Check it out: Go to app.magicschool.ai for information and to sign up. Or get the new Chrome extension from the Chrome webstore.

Learn more: Magic School Certification Courses

SchoolAI

SchoolAI is an all-in-one AI learning platform built specifically for K-12 education. It empowers teachers to create customized, safe, and interactive AI-powered activities—known as "Spaces"—where students receive personalized tutoring, practice skills, and explore topics while educators monitor progress and intervene in real time.

How it works: Teachers sign up for a free trial on SchoolAI.com and can then choose from pre-made AI experiences (called “Spaces”), or create their own custom experiences tailored to their curriculum and students' needs. They share an invite link with their students, who can then interact with the AI experience without creating accounts themselves. Teachers can monitor and control the AI interactions in real time through Mission Control, which generates insights and summaries to help teachers see what students understand and who needs support.

Pricing and terms:  SchoolAI.com offers the following plans:


  • Free: Includes access to pre-made Spaces, custom Space creation, teacher tools, and browser extension features with generous classroom usage allowances.
  • Pro & Scale (School/District Pricing): Adds unlimited Space sessions, SIS-powered rostering, full LMS integration, student-level insights, and district management tools.

See the SchoolAI pricing page for current plan details.

Check it out: Go to schoolai.com for information or to sign up.

Learn more: 10 powerful ways to use custom chatbots in the classroom

Brisk Teaching

Brisk Teaching (briskteaching.com) is a is a free extension that uses AI to help teachers save time and improve their teaching methods. Brisk integrates with Google Classroom, Docs, Slides, YouTube, Canvas, Schoology, and now Microsoft tools allowing teachers to: create instructional materials, provide feedback, evaluate student writing, adjust reading levels, generate personalized curriculum, and analyze class progress. 

How it works:

  • Go to Brisk Teaching to get started. (Just type in your email address and submit.)
  • Create an account with your Google or Microsoft login credentials
  • Make sure you install the Brisk extension for Google Chrome or the Brisk add-on for Microsoft Edge. Once it's installed, you'll start seeing the little Brisk "B" icon in the bottom right corner in your browser whenever Brisk is available. 
  • Pin Brisk to your toolbar. (This will make it easy to access any time.)

Pricing and terms:  Brisk Teaching offers several plans for educators:

  • Free: A "Free Forever" plan for individual educators including core AI tools, feedback generators, and standard usage limits (plus a 14-day free trial of premium features for new users).

  • Brisk Educator Pro ($99.99/year): Unlocks faster AI models, unlimited usage, advanced feedback styles, and writing process insights.

  • Brisk for Schools & Districts (Custom Pricing): Adds an admin dashboard, custom data privacy agreements (DPAs), and dedicated support.

Check it out: Go to briskteaching.com to install the Chrome extension and sign up.

Learn more: 

  • Create lesson plans, quizzes, and presentations in seconds with this must-have Google Chrome extension
  • Transform any online resource into interactive learning with Brisk Boost
  • Brisk Next: Smarter, personalized planning for your classroom

Kira

Kira (kira-learning.com) is an all-in-one AI instructional platform designed to connect lesson planning, classroom activities, grading, and student intervention in one place. Built with K–12 privacy protections (FERPA and COPPA compliant), it helps teachers build standards-aligned lessons while giving students safe, teacher-monitored spaces to practice concepts with AI.

How it works: Teachers can use Kira's suite of educator tools—including Lesson Studio, Rubric Generator, Text Leveler, and Essay QuickGrader—to prep materials and grade student writing. For student-facing learning, teachers can launch ChatPods (guided AI chat spaces tied to a specific lesson) or assign interactive practice where Kira adapts its hints based on student mistakes.

Pricing and terms:


  • Free: Free for individual teachers and students, including access to Kira's AI teacher tools, Lesson Studio, and course library.

  • School & District Plans (Custom Quote): Adds school-wide mastery analytics, MTSS intervention tracking, and full LMS integration.

Check it out: kira-learning.com

Learn more: Watch AI Literacy in Everyday Learning with Kira

Toddle

Toddle (toddleapp.com) is an all-in-one, AI-powered learning management and curriculum planning platform built specifically for K–12 schools. Rather than acting as a single standalone generator, Toddle AI is woven directly into every stage of a teacher’s daily workflow—connecting curriculum mapping, unit and lesson design, assessments, student portfolios, and report card writing in one privacy-certified hub.

How it works: Schools and teachers work inside a unified workspace that supports over 200 preloaded curriculum frameworks (including IB, Common Core, NGSS, Cambridge, and Understanding by Design). Built-in AI assistants let teachers co-design courses and lesson plans from a prompt, run a first-pass AI evaluation on handwritten or digital work (with teacher sign-off before sharing), generate evidence-backed progress report comments, and launch safe, teacher-controlled student AI tutors.

Pricing and terms:


  • School & District Plans (Custom Quote): Toddle is built for whole-school or district adoption (starting around $24/user/year depending on selected modules). Schools can request a personalized demo and a 2–3 week free trial.

Check it out: toddleapp.com 

Learn more: See how teachers worldwide use Toddle AI to teach more creatively and reach every learner

WeWillWrite

WeWillWrite is an innovative platform that makes writing more playful, social, and fun for students. The tool encourages creative expression, peer collaboration, and instant feedback—three key components that motivate students to write.

How it works: WeWillWrite allows students to write in short, timed bursts in response to creative prompts while reading and voting on their classmates' anonymous responses in real time. Teachers choose from a library of ready-to-use challenges and use AI-assisted insights to highlight strong writing moves.

Pricing and terms:

 

  • Basic (Free): Includes core classroom challenges and a monthly curation of 8 writing sets.
  • Premium ($9/month or $60/year): Unlocks unlimited access to all content, AI literary device analysis, student history, and custom challenge creation.
  • School and District Plans (Custom Quote): Available for schools and districts with 10 or more teachers.

Check it out: WeWillWrite.com

Learn more: Fun, low-stakes, gamified student writing with WeWillWrite

Groovelit

Groovelit (groovelit.com) is a gamified writing platform designed to help 5th–10th grade students find their voice. In under 10 minutes a day, students engage in bite-sized, game-based writing challenges that reward strong vocabulary, literary devices, and creativity in real time.

How it works:  Teachers sign up for a free account, select from hundreds of pre-made prompts (from debating hot topics to rewriting classic stories), and share a join code. As students write, Groovelit's AI scores criteria like figurative language, pacing, and evidence live on screen.

See Groovelit in action in this video.

Pricing and terms: Groovelit has a generous free forever plan with unlimited access to core features and hundreds of writing prompts, plus paid school and district plans for mastery tracking and data reporting.

Check it out: Groovelit.com

Learn more: Groovelit: Every student has a story. Help them tell it

TeachAid

TeachAid (teachaid.ca) automates lesson prep as your AI teaching assistant. It includes unit and lesson planning, assessment planning, interactive presentations, and learning activities all in one spot.

How it works: Create an account at teachaid.ca to build complete, standards-aligned units with AI—generating daily lesson materials, slide decks, assessments, and rubrics together so every resource stays aligned to the same unit goals.

Pricing and terms: 

 

  • Free: Free forever for teachers, including unit and lesson planning, basic differentiation, and presentation/resource generation.
  • Premium ($15/month or $100/year): Adds advanced assessment tools, IEP support, custom assignments, and cross-curricular capabilities.
  • Enterprise (Custom Pricing): District-wide curriculum integration, professional development workshops, and dedicated support.

Check it out: Go to teachaid.ca to get started.

Check it out: 10 ways TeachAid will transform your teaching

FlintK12

Flint K-12 is an AI platform designed to help teachers save time on content creation while providing engaging, interactive AI tutoring and practice activities for students.

How it works: Teachers can use Flint's AI chat for prep tasks or create custom student activities in three steps: choose an activity type, upload custom content (like a textbook chapter, PDF, or rubric), and preview before sharing. Flint emphasizes safe, productive AI use for students with personalized, immediate feedback and full teacher oversight.

Pricing and terms:  Flint offers a very generous free plan for teachers.

  • Free:  Free for teachers and their students, with no student limit. A free workspace can have up to 3 teachers and admins.
  • Paid Plans: Paid school plan for schools and districts that want Flint for every teacher. Pricing varies by school size.

Check it out: Go to the Flintk12.com website for information and to sign up.

Learn more: What is Flint? 5 reasons to try this school-safe AI tool

TeachShare

Teachshare is a community-driven AI platform that helps educators create, differentiate, and share high-quality, standards-aligned learning resources. Its core mission is to amplify a teacher's unique touch on the curriculum, not replace it, by providing smart tools that simplify classroom workflows.

How it works: TeachShare's AI tools help you create lesson plans, exercises, and worksheets in seconds. You can differentiate assignments to meet individual student needs, align resources to specific curriculum standards, translate content into over 10 languages with a single click, and assign auto-graded digital activities.

Pricing and terms:  Teachshare has a tiered pricing structure that includes a generous free option.

  • Free: This plan provides 5 resources a week, in every format.
  • Individual Premium ($30/month): For individual teachers who want unlimited creation.

Check it out: Go to the TeachShare.com website for information and to sign up.

Suno

Suno is a generative AI music creation program that generates realistic songs combining vocals and instrumentation, or purely instrumental tracks, from simple text prompts.

How it works: Enter a text prompt describing the topic, style, or lyrics you want (such as a catchy song to help students remember vocabulary, historical events, or math formulas), and Suno generates a complete track in seconds.

Pricing and terms:  Suno offers a variety of plans, including a free version and two paid subscriptions, for creating AI-generated music.

  • Free Plan: 50 credits daily (enough for roughly 10 songs per day) for non-commercial classroom use.
  • Pro Plan ($8/month billed annually or $10/month billed monthly): 2,500 credits per month (~500 songs), priority queue access, and commercial usage rights.
  • Premier Plan ($24/month billed annually or $30/month billed monthly): 10,000 credits per month (~2,000 songs) for heavy creators.

Eduaide.ai

Eduaide.ai  is an AI-powered teaching assistant designed to help teachers with lesson planning, instructional design, and generating educational content. It offers a resource generator, teaching assistant, feedback bot and AI chat.

How it works: Select your grade level and subject area, choose from categorized instructional templates (from graphic organizers and escape rooms to IEPs and bell ringers), and customize the generated resources in the built-in workspace.

Pricing and terms: Eduaide.ai offers a tiered pricing model with a generous free plan and a paid option for more advanced use. 

  • Free: Freemium tier with roughly 15–20 generations per month and access to core tools.
  • Pro ($5.99/month or $49.99/year): Unlocks unlimited generations, longer prompt inputs, the AI assistant "Erasmus," and all new features.
  • Institutional Plans (Custom Pricing): Volume discounts, professional development, and dedicated support for schools and districts.

Check it out: Go to the eduaide.ai website for information and to sign up.

Curriculum Genie

Curriculum Genie (curriculumgenie.learning-genie.com) is a smart, efficient, and secure AI-powered platform by Learning Genie designed to help educators create and transform curriculum and instructional materials aligned to standards across all 50 U.S. states.

How it works: Sign in to generate complete, structured Unit Plans or Lesson Plans in minutes. You can localize content to reflect your students' communities and cultures, differentiate lessons for specific learning needs, support student-teacher co-creation, and export all plans and resources directly to Google Docs and Google Slides.

Pricing and terms: 

  • Free: Includes unlimited standards-aligned lesson plans plus 4 free unit plan credits upon sign-up (with 2 additional free unit credits earned each time you share a unit on social media).
  • Paid Plan ($20/month billed monthly): Unlocks all features and allows you to create up to 25 unit/lesson plans per month.

Teaching Aides

Kami

Kami (kamiapp.com) is an interactive digital classroom and document annotation platform that has built a comprehensive, privacy-first suite of AI tools right into the PDFs, worksheets, and files teachers already use. Rather than giving students an open-ended chatbot, Kami uses structured, teacher-controlled AI tools to scaffold reading, generate questions, and speed up grading while keeping student data private.

How it works: Open any PDF, Google Doc, Slide, or Word file in Kami (or use the Kami Companion toolbar across web pages, Google Docs, and Google Slides). Teachers and students can use several built-in AI features:

  • Teacher Creation & Grading: Use Questions AI to automatically turn existing worksheets or readings into interactive questions, and Suggested Feedback to draft personalized comments on student work (which teachers review and edit before sharing).

  • Student Accessibility ("Understand" Tools): Teachers can toggle on specific supports per student or assignment, allowing learners to Explain complex text or images in plain language, Summarize key ideas, Translate content, or Relevel passages to match their reading level.

  • Kami Coach (Beta): An AI-powered math coaching tool that provides step-by-step hints during teacher-assigned math activities while giving teachers real-time insights into student thinking.

Pricing and terms: 

  • Basic (Free Forever): Includes 10+ essential annotation and collaboration tools, Google Drive/OneDrive integration, and 1,000+ templates. New teacher accounts also receive a 30-day free trial of the full Teacher plan.
  • Teacher Plan ($149/year): Unlocks all 40+ tools and features, AI-powered accessibility and feedback tools, and full LMS integrations (Google Classroom, Canvas, Schoology, and Microsoft Teams).
  • School & District Plans (Custom Quote): Includes domain-wide deployment, admin AI controls, and district-level analytics.

Check it out: kamiapp.com

Learn more: Kami in the classroom: 10 templates plus tips for using them

Grouper

Grouper (grouper.school) is a free app that helps you create student groups – and keep them on track – during small-group learning.

How it works: Grouper allows you to instantly generate random groups of any size. Groupings can be randomized, customized, or based on student attributes, and can be used immediately or saved for later.

Pricing and terms: 

  • Free: Core features for creating random, customized, or attribute-based groups.

  • Pro ($6.99/month per teacher billed annually): Adds co-teacher access, unlimited student attributes, student roles, smartboard tools, and AI-assisted student data imports.

  • Central (Custom Pricing): District-level license management, bulk student imports, and usage reports.

Check it out: Grouper.school

Learn more: 10 ways to manage group work in the classroom

Socrait

Socrait is a voice-enabled AI-powered class assistant designed to save teachers time and reduce burnout. It works by listening to what a teacher says in the classroom and automatically turning spoken words into actionable data. The goal is to handle administrative tasks like behavior tracking, attendance, and communication, allowing teachers to focus on instruction.

How it works: Activate the Socrait mobile app with a "Stream" button before class. As you teach, the AI identifies and logs key events such as praise, warnings, reminders, and attendance in real time (without permanently recording audio), then provides an end-of-lesson summary and drafts follow-up emails.

Pricing and terms:  Free for individual teachers to use with one class (and offering free educator access for the 2026–27 school year); school site licenses are available for full-building deployment.

Check it out: Socrait.com

Learn more: Socrait Events and Webinars

Goblin Tools

Goblin Tools is a collection of small, simple, single-task tools designed to help neurodivergent people with tasks they find overwhelming or difficult. The tools include Magic ToDo, Formalizer, Judge, Estimator, and Compiler and more.

How it works: Visit the website or download the app and select the tool you need:

  • Magic ToDo: Breaks down a large or overwhelming task into smaller, manageable steps (with an adjustable "spiciness" level for how detailed the breakdown is).

  • Formalizer & The Judge: Rewrites text to match a specific tone or analyzes how an email/message might be perceived emotionally.

  • Compiler & The Estimator: Turns scattered brain-dump notes into an actionable checklist and estimates how long tasks will take.

  • The Professor & Consultant: Explains complex topics simply or weighs pros and cons for tough decisions.

Pricing and terms: The web version of Goblin Tools is completely free; the iOS/Android mobile apps are a small one-time purchase to help keep the web version free.

Check it out: goblin.tools

Khanmigo

Khanmigo is an AI-powered learning tool developed by Khan Academy that acts as a Socratic virtual tutor for students and an instructional planning assistant for teachers

How it works:

  • For Teachers: Generates standards-aligned lesson outlines, warm-up activities, exit tickets, rubrics, and summaries of student class mastery.
  • For Students: Provides step-by-step hints and Socratic guidance across math, science, and humanities without simply giving away the final answer.

Pricing and terms: Khanmigo for Teachers is 100% free for educators in over 40 countries (supported by Microsoft). Student and parent accounts are available via school/district partnerships or individual subscriptions ($4/month or $44/year).

Check it out: To learn more about Khanmigo, visit the Khan Academy website or read the post Khanmigo For Teachers Now 100% Free for All U.S. Teachers, Thanks to Microsoft Support to get your Khanmigo access.

Quiz Generators & AI Games

Padlet Arcade

Padlet Arcade (formerly Padlet TA) is a free, AI-powered educational game creation platform developed by Padlet. It allows teachers to turn any lesson, topic, uploaded file, webpage link, or YouTube video into an interactive classroom review game in under a minute—or browse and remix thousands of pre-made games created by other educators.

How it works:

 

  • Create in Seconds: Go to arcade.padlet.com, click Create, and enter a topic, paste a webpage or YouTube URL, or upload your own course notes/files.
  • Choose Your Game Format: Padlet Arcade's AI generates playable activities across multiple formats—including Multiple Choice, Matching, Fill-in-the-Blank, Flashcards (with audio), Memory Tiles, Sequencing, and Sorting challenges.
  • Customize & Remix: Edit any question, answer option, or explanation before publishing, or "Remix" any game from the public library to change its game format, adjust the difficulty, or translate it into another language.
  • Zero-Friction Student Play: Share games instantly via a link, QR code, Google Classroom, or Microsoft Teams—students don't need an account or login to play. Built-in leaderboards track scores and speed, and you can also export games to PDF for offline use.

Pricing and terms: Padlet Arcade is completely free for teachers and students (with broader Padlet for Schools institutional plans available for full school/district management).

Check it out: Create and play free learning games at arcade.padlet.com

Genially AI Games

Genially AI Games lets teachers turn any lesson topic into an interactive, professionally animated classroom game in seconds—no coding or graphic design experience required. Instead of plain text quizzes, Genially adapts visual game templates like Battleship, Defend the Castle, Two Truths and a Lie, and The Big Spin directly to your subject matter.

How it works:

  • Pick a Game Format: Browse Genially's library of interactive game templates (including quizzes, word challenges, digital escape rooms, and team battles) and test-play them right on the page without even signing up.
  • Describe Your Topic: Type a short sentence describing what you want to teach (or upload a PDF/document for context), and Genially's AI automatically writes the questions, answers, and game text to fit the template.
  • Customize & Share: Tweak colors, fonts, images, or questions in Genially's drag-and-drop editor—or ask the AI for quick revisions—then share a direct link so students can play on any device.

Pricing and terms: 

  • Free: Includes unlimited creations, 1,000+ free templates, live game sessions (up to 50 participants per session), and 500 AI credits per year to generate games, questions, and interactive elements.
  • Paid Plans (Edu Pro / Master / Team): Unlock higher AI credit allowances (2,000 to 10,000+ credits/year), premium templates, offline HTML/PDF/video downloads, and larger live session caps (starting around $10–$50/month billed annually, with discounted student/educator and school plans available).

Check it out: Try and create free classroom games at genially.com/create/ai-games

Wayground

Wayground, formerly Quizizz, has evolved from a simple quiz platform into a more versatile, supplemental learning platform. The rebrand reflects its expanded focus on providing a comprehensive AI-supported hub for instruction, practice, and assessment.

How it works: Upload a document (PDF, PPT, DOC), paste a webpage or YouTube link, or type a prompt to generate interactive quizzes, lessons, and flashcards. Teachers can also use AI Actions (to translate or adjust question difficulty), AI Analyze (to spot skill gaps), and AI-Powered Answer Explanations to give students step-by-step help when they miss a question.

Pricing and terms: Wayground offers a tiered pricing model with a free plan and paid options for individuals and schools.

  • Starter (Free): Includes Wayground AI content generation, interactive quizzes and lessons, and basic accommodations like Read Aloud (up to 20 saved activities).
  • School & District (Custom Pricing): Unlimited activities, shared school libraries, advanced accommodations, and deep LMS/SIS integrations (Google Classroom, Canvas, Clever).

Check it out: Wayground.com

Knowt

Knowt (knowt.com) is an AI-powered study and classroom review platform—and one of the most popular free alternatives to Quizlet. It turns teacher notes, PDFs, slides, and YouTube videos into interactive flashcards, practice quizzes, study guides, and live classroom review games in seconds.

How it works: Upload a PDF, paste a YouTube link, or import existing study sets directly from Quizlet, Kahoot, or Wayground with a couple of clicks. Knowt's AI ("Kai") automatically extracts key terms and builds flashcards, multiple-choice practice tests, and audio summaries. Students get unlimited access to spaced-repetition "Learn" mode and matching games at no cost.

Pricing and terms: 

  • Free: Unlimited flashcard creation, free "Learn" mode, practice tests, and one-click imports from Quizlet and Kahoot for both teachers and students.
  • Paid Plans (Knowt Plus / Ultra): Optional student and teacher upgrades unlock unlimited AI lecture recording, AP/SAT/ACT prep rooms, and custom exam study plans.

Check it out: knowt.com

QuestionWell

QuestionWell generates an endless supply of questions so teachers can focus on what matters. Just input some reading, and the AI will write essential questions, learning objectives, and aligned multiple choice questions.

How it works: Paste a reading or link, add your topic and standards, and QuestionWell generates questions you can export directly to Kahoot, Quizlet, Wayground, Blooket, Moodle, Google Slides, Docs, Forms, Canvas, Schoology, and more.

Pricing and terms: QuestionWell offers a generous free plan that is honestly enough for almost all your quiz making needs.

  • Free Plan: Generate and edit multiple-choice and essential questions from readings up to ~1,000 words, with exports to all major quiz platforms.
  • Premium Plan ($5.83/month billed annually at $70, or $7/month): Increases reading limits to 10,000 words, unlocks fill-in-the-blank and short-answer questions, adds AI images, and includes standards alignment.

Check it out: http://questionwell.org

Learn more about export options: https://questionwell.org/export-options

Formative AI

Formative has a long history as an assignment and quiz platform, but it has recently incorporated a powerful AI assistant named Luna and other integrated AI features. This allows teachers to generate new standard-aligned questions and hints for learners, as well as student feedback.

How it works: Chat with Luna to create instant assessments from existing PDFs and images, generate individual questions from prompts, or produce hints and rubric-aligned feedback for student submissions.

Pricing and terms: AI features are available across all account tiers:


  • Free Teacher Plan: Unlimited lesson, assignment, and assessment creation, real-time student tracking, and basic AI generation.

  • Paid Teacher Plan ($16/month): Unlocks advanced question types, auto-grading, anti-cheating features, and expanded AI feedback tools.

  • School & District Plan (Custom Quote): Centralized data dashboards, common assessments, and administrative controls.

Check it out: formative.com

Gibbly

Gibbly is a versatile AI tool designed to save teachers time on lesson prep by generating ready-to-use lessons, assessments, quizzes, and gamified review assignments in minutes. It's an excellent platform for creating engaging and curriculum-aligned content.

How it works: Use Gibbly's AI Lesson Generator to build full lesson slides from a single topic, or use the AI Quiz Generator to turn a YouTube video, document, or pasted text into a gamified classroom quiz.

Pricing and terms: 

  • Starter (Free): Provides 10,000 AI tokens per month, unlimited classes, Google exports, and SSO.
  • Premium (Starts at $8.99/month): Unlocks unlimited AI tokens, smarter AI models, and translation tools.
  • Schools & Districts (Custom Pricing): Adds professional development, customization, and dedicated support.

Conker

Conker lets you create multiple-choice, read-and-respond, and fill-in-the-blank quizzes for students at a variety of levels on specific topics. It will also let you copy/paste reading material to generate quizzes. 

How it works: Enter a topic or paste a reading passage, choose your grade level and question types, and Conker generates a quiz you can share with a student join code, export to Google Forms, or print with an answer key.

Pricing and terms:  

  • Free Plan: Generate and share up to 5 quizzes and collect up to 50 student responses, including Google Forms export.
  • Basic ($3.99/month) & Pro ($9.99/month): Increase limits to 10 quizzes/100 responses (Basic) or unlimited quizzes, responses, and longer source readings (Pro).
  • School/District (Custom Quote): Adds LMS integrations and admin controls.

Check it out: Conker.ai

Twee

Twee is an AI-powered tool designed to simplify lesson planning for English teachers by generating questions, dialogues, stories, letters, articles, multiple-choice questions, true/false statements, and more.

How it works: Create an account at twee.com, pick a specialized language tool (such as creating gap-fill exercises, discussion questions, or leveled dialogues from a YouTube video), and click "Do the magic!"

Pricing and terms:

  • Free Trial: Includes 5 trial runs for most tools, 500 text-to-audio credits, and access to a free library of ESL lessons.
  • Basic ($6.50/month billed annually) & Pro ($10.50/month billed annually): Unlock 100 to unlimited monthly tool runs, 2,500–5,000 audio credits, and AI student response checking.
  • Twee Schools (Custom Pricing): Institutional licensing with higher audio limits and dedicated support.

Reflection, Feedback & Collaboration Tools

Snorkl

Snorkl is an innovative educational platform that uses AI to provide students with instant personalized feedback on their responses to questions or prompts assigned by their teachers.

How it works: Students solve a problem or answer a prompt on a digital whiteboard (drawing, typing, inserting equations, or uploading images) while explaining their thinking out loud. Snorkl's multimodal AI analyzes both what they wrote and what they said, giving instant, timestamped feedback to deepen understanding.

Pricing and terms: Free for teachers to use across unlimited classes with generous activity allowances; custom quotes are available for School and District plans with unlimited usage and LMS integrations. Request a quote for School/District plans.

Check it out: snorkl.app

Learn more: 10 ways to provide instant feedback to students

Padlet AI Recipes

Padlet AI Recipes (formerly Magic Padlet) is a built-in generative AI feature within Padlet that builds an entire interactive board from a short description—helping teachers quickly spin up discussion boards, timelines, maps, lesson plans, and collaborative templates for students.

How it works: Click + Make at the top of your Padlet dashboard and select from the AI recipes section—such as Discussion board, Timeline of events, Lesson plans, Rubrics, Class activity creator, or Custom board. Enter guided details like grade level, subject, and topic (you can even ask it to generate a geographic Map or a "mostly blank" template with pre-labeled columns for students to fill in), then edit and share the generated board as needed.

Pricing and terms: Available across Padlet's free and paid educator tiers:

  • Free (Neon): Includes up to 3 active padlets, 20MB file uploads, and access to AI recipes for individual Teacher, Personal, and School staff accounts.

  • Gold ($9.99/month or $69.99/year) & Platinum ($14.99/month or $99.99/year): Expand limits to 20 or unlimited padlets and larger file uploads (100MB–500MB).

  • Classroom ($199/year) & School/District (Starts at $1,000/year): Multi-teacher plans with unlimited padlets, student accounts, LMS integrations, and admin controls over student AI access.

Check it out: Log in at padlet.com and click + Make to try AI recipes.

Learn more: 20 useful ways to use Padlet in the classroom

FigJam Jambot & AI

FigJam is an online collaborative whiteboard platform with built-in AI features that help teachers and students brainstorm, organize ideas, and build visual lessons quickly. FigJam's AI capabilities include both the Jambot widget and platform-wide AI tools that streamline lesson prep and group work.

How it works:

  • Jambot: An AI widget that lives directly on your whiteboard. Connect it to sticky notes or type a prompt to brainstorm ideas ("Ideate!"), condense notes ("Summarize"), or generate quick interactive code snippets.

  • FigJam AI Tools: Built directly into the toolbar to Generate Boards and Diagrams (mind maps, flowcharts, timelines), Sort and Summarize Stickies from student brainstorms by theme, and Generate/Edit Visuals right on the board.

Pricing and terms: 

  • Figma for Education (Free): Verified K–12 and higher-education teachers and students receive the full Professional plan completely free, including unlimited FigJam boards, unlimited version history, and increased monthly AI credits.

  • Starter (Free for non-verified accounts): Includes up to 3 collaborative files and basic monthly AI credits.

  • Standard Commercial Plans: For non-educational users, paid plans start at $16/month per Full seat (Professional) and $55/month per Full seat (Organization).

Check it out:Figma for Education

  • Guide to FigJam

EnlightenAI

EnlightenAI (enlightenme.ai) is designed specifically for educators, providing personalized grading and feedback aligned with your teaching style, voice, and rubric. Unlike general-purpose chatbots, EnlightenAI does not train its AI models on user data—instead, it learns from a few of your graded examples to match your exact standards.

How it works:  

  • Set up your assignment: Import student work (or sync with Google Classroom) and attach your rubric.
  • Calibrate the AI with five examples: Grade just five submissions with the AI's assistance so it learns your scoring style and tone.
  • Generate grades and feedback: Bulk-grade the remaining submissions, review and edit every comment before returning work, and generate targeted follow-up resources.

Pricing and terms:  EnlightenMe.ai offers a few plans to suit different needs.

  • Free Teacher: Includes 500 graded submissions per month, Google Classroom integration, adaptive AI grading, and bulk CSV imports. (Get access to the full version for 30 days when you sign up)
  • School License (Custom Quote): Unlimited pooled grading, Clever/Canvas roster sync, shared rubric libraries, and admin reporting.

Check it out: Enlightenme.AI

Learn more: See teacher stories, case studies and get tips and tricks Enlightenme.ai/blog

Class Companion

Class Companion is an AI-powered platform (now part of Panorama Education) that helps teachers provide students with personalized, real-time feedback and coaching on written assignments and short-answer practice.

How it works: Teachers create or import an assignment and rubric, and students submit their responses inside Class Companion. The AI provides instant rubric-aligned feedback and Socratic hints—guiding students through multiple rounds of revision while giving teachers real-time insights into student progress and copy/paste behavior.

Pricing and terms: 

  • Free for Teachers and Students: The core platform remains free for individual teachers and students, including instant AI feedback, basic insights, and the public assignment library.
  • School/District Plans (Custom Quote): Adds LMS roster/grade syncing (Canvas, Schoology, Google Classroom), advanced analytics, and district-wide controls.

Check it out: classcompanion.com

Grammarly

Grammarly is an AI-powered writing assistant that checks grammar, spelling, clarity, and tone across browsers, documents, and email clients—and helps teachers and students draft and revise writing faster.

How it works: Type directly into the Grammarly editor or use the browser extension and desktop apps to get real-time writing suggestions, tone adjustments, and generative AI rewrites inside Google Docs, Word, Gmail, and LMS text boxes.

Pricing and terms: 


  • Free Plan: Includes foundational grammar, spelling, and punctuation checks, tone detection, and 100 generative AI prompts per month.
  • Pro Plan ($12/member/month billed annually, $20/month billed quarterly, or $30/month billed monthly): Unlocks full-sentence rewrites, plagiarism and AI text checks, tone adjustments, and 2,000 generative AI prompts per month.

Check it out: Grammarly.com

Parlay Genie

Parlay Genie (part of Parlay) is an AI-powered discussion prompt and Socratic seminar generator that helps teachers run engaging written and verbal class discussions.

How it works: Enter a topic or paste a link to an article, PDF, or YouTube video, select your grade level, and choose a Written or Verbal RoundTable. Parlay Genie generates higher-order discussion questions, learning goals, and peer feedback instructions—then provides real-time participation tracking, discussion summaries, and personalized student feedback.

Pricing and terms:

  • Free Plan: Includes unlimited courses and students (up to 6 active RoundTables at a time), AI Genie prompt creation, AI student feedback, and basic discussion visualizations.
  • Individual Premium ($120/year): Unlocks unlimited active RoundTables, co-teacher access, data exports, student reports, and video support in Verbal RoundTables.
  • School & District Plans (Custom Quote): Adds admin dashboards and SIS/LMS integrations.
